definitions.explanation: The part that follows; what comes next in a series or story.

examples.japanese: {続|つづ}きは{明日|あした}{話|はな}します。
examples.english: I'll tell you the rest tomorrow.

examples.japanese: この{映画|えいが}の{続|つづ}きが{見|み}たい。
examples.english: I want to see the sequel to this movie.

examples.japanese: {雨|あめ}{続|つづ}きで{洗濯物|せんたくもの}が{乾|かわ}かない。
examples.english: The laundry won't dry because of the continuous rain.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
・{続|つづ}きを{読|よ}む/{見|み}る (to read/watch the continuation)
・{続|つづ}きは〜 (the rest is ~, to be continued ~)
・〜{続|つづ}き (continuous ~, a series of ~)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
・{雨|あめ}{続|つづ}き (continuous rain)
・{不運|ふうん}{続|つづ}き (a series of misfortunes)
・{続|つづ}きもの (serial, series)

RELATED VERB:
・{続|つづ}く (to continue) - this noun is derived from the verb
